skills.name: migrate-config
skills.description: Move a niwa workspace's config SOURCE repository off the deprecated whole-repo layout onto the `.niwa/workspace.toml` subtree layout, or repoint a workspace at a different config repo without breaking it. The symptom users report is the clone -- "why is niwa pulling down my entire config repo?" -- since the old layout clones the whole repository where the new one fetches only the `.niwa/` directory. Also use when niwa rejects a source as ambiguous after a half-finished restructure left both layouts' markers in place, when someone wants `workspace.toml` moved into a `.niwa/` directory, or when niwa's post-apply note about a deprecated source needs acting on. Load it before any `source_url` edit: the auto-discovered `<repo>-overlay` slug derives from the source repo's name, so hand-editing `~/.config/niwa/config.toml` to point at a renamed or new config repo silently breaks overlay discovery and drops the workspace's overlay with no error. This is a niwa workspace config source repository -- NOT Claude Code settings, hooks, permissions, or `settings.json`, and not generic config-file migration.
